title: The Forest River Band: a string band with no clarinet or piano
summary: He describes his small band of cornet, violin, two guitars and bass violin, with no trombone, piano or clarinet.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Yeah, only, yeah. Only him. I took lessons from him. Only him. Now, the name of the little band was Forest River Band, you know? Forest River Band. Of course, River. That was the name of your band? Yeah, band, yeah. We had six pieces, I think. Two guitar, bass violin, cornet, and violin. That makes five, I guess. Did you bass two guitars? Yeah, but I wasn't playing my music, though.
Did they have any trombone in the band ever? No, no. We didn't have any. No piano then, either? No piano, no. No piano.
